decision: Source/assay gate incomplete; support no current numerical composition stage. The recovered sources do not yet supply an authenticated replicated, matched absolute-plus-relative EMC comparison. Preserve potentially suitable relative multiplex measurements as pending, not assay-invalid or biological-negative evidence.
before_values: No new numerical EMC cell-count outcomes inspected. Only source methods/definitions and previously evaluated source limitations read. Source owner retains responsibility for eligibility, full condition mapping, source retrieval and any later prospective numerical freeze.

source_checks.measurement: Manual total positive-cell counts in five selected0.2mm2 fields, intratumoral and marginal areas; almost same fields across CD68 PG-M1, CD163 EPR19518 and CD204 SRA-E5 serial slides. Exact marginal-field/area denominator and exported total-versus-mean units must be confirmed before density conversion. No CD3/CD8 assay.
source_checks.cell_identity: Authors call these macrophage/TAM markers. Inspected methods do not state a per-positive-cell macrophage morphology rule, tumor-cell exclusion condition, CD45 colocalization, intensity cutoff or mutually exclusive phenotype classifier. Preserve author-defined CD68/CD163/CD204-positive-cell counts; this absence of an explicit rule does not establish that tumor cells were counted or that the assay is invalid.
source_checks.conditions: 75 surgically resected cases2004–2017; no preoperative chemotherapy/radiotherapy, original/WHO-revised pathological labels. Margin usually non-sarcomatous tissue adjacent to tumor; two atypical-lipomatous-tumor exceptions use marginal tumor tissue and require separate disposition. Preservation/fixation and complete donor/site/core linkage remain source-metadata questions, not invented FFPE assumptions.
source_checks.consequence: Useful separate compartment/marker counts may exist, but this assay alone cannot measure a macrophage-to-T-cell index. One source-labelled EMC case cannot furnish a replicated population contrast or independent donor bootstrap. No new numeric values read.

source_checks.inspected_scope: Method subsections tissue microarrays, multiplex IHC and staining/image analysis only
source_checks.measurement: FFPE regions selected for high tumor-cell abundance. DAPI size/roundness/intensity identifies cells; whole-cell fluorescence thresholds define CD3+ T cells, CD3+/CD8+ cytotoxic T cells and CD68+ author-labelled macrophages. CD163 is absent. CD3/CD8 coexpression supplies a stronger T-phenotype definition than CD8 alone; the exact phenotype and threshold remain source-specific.
source_checks.units_and_aggregation: Phenotype abundance is percent of total cells per TMA core, later combined for cores from the same patient. Source does not specify count-weighted versus core-mean combination in inspected methods.1266 technical cores do not mean1266 donors; source descriptions of approximatelyseven or six±3 cores must not be reconstructed into an invented exact per-donor roster. These percentages do not give cells/mm2 without actual count and usable area.
source_checks.cell_identity_limits: CD68 classification lacks a stated CD45/tumor-negative condition or mutually exclusive phenotype exclusion. Retain source-labelled CD68+ phenotype, not independently authenticated macrophage polarization/function. Relative CD68/CD3 phenotype index could be computable after identity, aggregation and public measurement linkage; same-cell assay does not by itself establish exclusive cell populations.
source_checks.consequence: Current generic-other-histotype EMC identity and individual public assay linkage remain owner pending. This is potentially suitable relative measurement evidence; it cannot currently establish the original joint absolute-density claim. No numeric EMC outcomes or image data read.

source_checks.measurement: Methods printed1773–1774: representative viable tumor0.6/1.0mm cores, serial sections; pathologist blinded to replicate and final diagnosis, mean replicate scores. H&E morphology counts TIL separately from positive-staining CD8/CD4 and other lymphocyte markers; divide by respective core area to report cells/mm2. No CD3 in listed assayed methods.
source_checks.consequence: A matched CD68/TIL comparison cannot be relabelled CD68/CD3 or CD68/CD8. Serial sections do not prove co-registered exclusive cell populations. Generic chondrosarcoma/complete EMC roster remains source-owner/prior-art-owner eligibility scope, not a new authenticated case asserted by this reviewer. No new count outcomes read.

source_checks.reuse: Exact R1 extracted supplement verified; original complete2020 XML/supplement caches unavailable in current portable checkout, so full-primary morphology reproduction is not claimed.
source_checks.measurement: Retained source note states positive macrophages/mm2 tumor and mean duplicate TMA cores. Published comparative CD68/TIL ratio adds1 to all values to avoid zeros. That density ratio and prior sparse EMC phenotype are published observations, not a new score discovery.
source_checks.consequence: Do not inherit a+1 pseudocount as a new primary endpoint, assume TIL equals marker-specific T cells, infer individual case linkage from histotype medians or count technical cores as donors. Source terminology is retained without claiming fresh validation.

prospective_finite_method_recommendation.status: Recommendation before new values, not permission to run unsupported current inputs. Owner must prospectively adopt/amend an exact finite contrast after source availability and prior-art/value gates; original four-pair family remains preserved.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.family: M in{CD68,CD163} crossed with T in{CD3,CD8}, each pair separately where source assay supports the actual phenotype. Do not require CD163 from a CD68-only source or silently substitute H&E TIL for CD3. Missing marker/condition is retained, never zero or excluded to select a favorable pair. A source with only CD68/CD3 can support that narrower measured pair if its independent value is established before outcomes.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.units: Within a matched donor/condition/compartment use actual source density counts/area, or true same-denominator phenotype percentages as a separate relative assay. Never mix percent area, H-score, ordinal bins, percent all cells and cells/mm2. Across studies compare direction/ranks for a genuinely matching pair and assay scope; do not pool values across clones, protocols or units.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.statistic: For each prespecified available pair, report both absolute source distributions and I=M/(M+T) as a marker-density or phenotype index. Report within-study donor-level tie-corrected rank AUC of I against each fixed available MLPS/SS/LGFMS stratum and equal-weight mean only across prospectively fixed present strata. All-source malignant histotypes and low-grade/translocation-associated strata remain predeclared sensitivity context. AUC0.70 plus one-sided95% donor-bootstrap lower bound above0.5 is a prospective strong-effect screening criterion, not a clinical cutoff; any hypothesis tests over the four-pair family require a frozen family-wide correction. Compatible independent-cohort same-pair direction and uncertainty are required for replication.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.zero_handling: M=T=0 gives undefined I, explicitly listed with missing denominator; never imputed0. T=0,M>0 gives I=1 but flagged with raw total counts/area or original percentages as sparse. Primary M/T division only where T>0, not an unbounded comparison endpoint. No+1 or tuned pseudocount primary rescue. Sensitivities retain all zero-T observations in the primary report, show nonzero-T-only and leave-one-donor results, and use only source-established quantitation thresholds; no invented numeric count floor or binomial precision from nonrandom selected fields.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.aggregation: Use donor as resampling unit; keep technical core/ROI details. Unequal valid ROI areas use sum counts/sum usable areas when raw quantities exist. Reuse published donor means when only means are released; do not reverse-engineer counts. Same-cell percentages require exact source patient aggregation or an explicit unresolved limit. Separate primary, recurrence, metastasis, pre/post treatment and unmatched compartments; no silent averaging of biological conditions or duplicate donors.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.controls_and_disproof: Freeze same-protocol control identities before values, with all eligible EMC specimens/conditions and missingness visible. The comparison fails usefulness if ratio advantage is explained by near-zero T alone with sparse absolute macrophages, depends on a single donor/core or comparator, fails independent matched-pair replication, or collapses under available grade/site/treatment/preservation/cellularity controls. A source with only one EMC contributes a descriptive condition, not a population CI or replication. Robust source differences are not treatment effects or proof of recruitment.
prospective_finite_method_recommendation.measurement_implication: Only a new robust composition distinction beyond published sparse/translocation-associated patterns would justify a targeted measurement: molecularly confirmed independent EMC and fixed lineage/grade controls, matched whole-section/ROI areas, immune/tumor segmentation, multi-marker cell identity and absolute counts plus cellularity. Score computation alone, caveats or known ratio reproduction do not establish clinical usefulness.

reuse_and_coverage_scope: R3 immune linkage failures and R8 bulk microenvironment/source-count limits reused exactly. RNA, deconvolution, qualitative biopsy descriptions and pan-sarcoma group means cannot supply these cell counts. Eligible individual EMC and new modern protein-imaging/source rosters remain source-owner/diagnostic pending. This method review is not complete public-EMC coverage or a final scientific outcome audit.
inference_limits: No M2 function, lysosomal tumor staining assertion, recruitment, causality, efficacy, prognosis, therapy-response prediction or RNA-to-cell identity inference. No biological negative or exhausted-search claim.
followthrough: Stop this one review batch. Current numerical comparison remains source-gated; reopen only with authentic all-condition case linkage, compatible measured pair/units/aggregation, independent native replication and a separately frozen useful contrast that survives prior-art review. Preserve inaccessible and accessible-unanalysed sources in distinct statuses.
